digest.component_or_area: completion-tool evidence banking and verdict reconciliation
propositions: At search exhaustion, BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE currently banks met=false treating absence-of-evidence as evidence-of-absence, producing false FAIL verdicts on criteria whose evidence exists but was not reached within the budget window.

The framework must distinguish three evidence outcomes (met, refuted, insufficient_evidence) via a tri-state marker (evidence_sufficient:false) riding alongside met=false, preserving fail-closed semantics while disambiguating exhaustion from genuine refutation.

The banking write path (fallback_record, upsert, record_criterion_verdict, harvest_structured_into_bank) must carry the marker only for framework-detected exhaustion, never from model tool output, with preserve-on-overwrite semantics ensuring genuine refutations replace insufficient-evidence entries.

All verdict consumers (schema validation, reconcile_verdict derivation, close_precheck refusal, rendering seams including audit page) must key on the marker to report insufficient evidence + remediation (re-verify or cite evidence in comments) instead of unmet criteria, while maintaining fail-closed blocking.

Operator anti-pattern detection: exhaustion must not pressure incorrect [operator-attested] tagging of code-verifiable criteria; remediation guidance explicitly steers toward untagged comment evidence citation and re-verify.
